        var odoo = ;
        var WS_VERSION = ;

        (function () {
            var JOB_ID   = ;
            var afterId  = 0;
            var lineCount = 0;
            var polling  = true;
            /* Polling is now a fallback: the websocket below delivers
             * events in real time and calls ``poll()`` immediately,
             * so the timer exists only for resiliency when the bus
             * drops (network blip, sleep/wake, Odoo worker restart).
             * 10 s keeps recovery time bounded without the old 600 ms
             * firehose of RPCs. */
            var POLL_MS  = 10000;

            var terminal    = document.getElementById('terminal');
            var cursor      = document.getElementById('cursor');
            var badge       = document.getElementById('state-badge');
            var statusText  = document.getElementById('status-text');
            var lineCountEl = document.getElementById('line-count');
            var searchInput    = document.getElementById('search-input');
            var searchCount    = document.getElementById('search-count');
            var searchCountTxt = document.getElementById('search-count-text');
            var searchEscTip   = document.getElementById('search-esc-tip');

            var DONE_STATES = ['done', 'failed', 'cancelled'];
            var userScrolledUp = false;

            /* Track whether the user has scrolled away from the bottom */
            terminal.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
                var atBottom = terminal.scrollHeight - terminal.scrollTop - terminal.clientHeight < 32;
                userScrolledUp = !atBottom;
            });

            function scrollToBottom() {
                if (!userScrolledUp) {
                    terminal.scrollTop = terminal.scrollHeight;
                }
            }

            /* ── RPC helper ── */
            function rpc(method, args) {
                return fetch('/web/dataset/call_kw', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'X-Csrf-Token': odoo.csrf_token,
                    },
                    credentials: 'same-origin',
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        jsonrpc: '2.0',
                        method: 'call',
                        id: Date.now(),
                        params: {
                            model: 'cloud.job',
                            method: method,
                            args: args,
                            kwargs: {},
                        },
                    }),
                }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
                  .then(function (r) { return r.result; });
            }

            /* ── ANSI SGR → styled spans ──
             *
             * git-aggregator, pip, docker compose and friends pepper
             * their stdout with ANSI colour escapes (``\x1b[…m``). The
             * terminal appended them verbatim before, rendering the ESC
             * byte as a ▯ box in the middle of every line. This mini
             * parser consumes those sequences and emits span nodes with
             * inline ``color``/``background``/``font-weight``/``opacity``
             * instead. Covers the common SGR set: reset, bold, dim, 8
             * basic fg/bg, 8 bright, 256-colour palette (38;5;N / 48;5;N)
             * and truecolour (38;2;R;G;B).
             */
            var ANSI_BASIC = {
                30:'#000', 31:'#e06060', 32:'#60c060', 33:'#e0c060', 34:'#6088e0', 35:'#c060c0', 36:'#4ec9b0', 37:'#d4d4d4',
                90:'#666', 91:'#f48771', 92:'#8ae066', 93:'#ffd060', 94:'#88aaff', 95:'#ff88ff', 96:'#88ffff', 97:'#fff'
            };
            function ansi256(n) {
                if (n < 16) return ANSI_BASIC[n < 8 ? 30 + n : 82 + n];
                if (n < 232) {
                    n -= 16;
                    var scale = [0, 95, 135, 175, 215, 255];
                    return 'rgb(' + scale[Math.floor(n/36)] + ',' + scale[Math.floor((n%36)/6)] + ',' + scale[n%6] + ')';
                }
                var v = 8 + (n - 232) * 10;
                return 'rgb(' + v + ',' + v + ',' + v + ')';
            }
            function applyAnsiCodes(state, raw) {
                var codes = (raw === '' ? [0] : raw.split(';').map(function (x) { return parseInt(x, 10); }));
                for (var i = 0; i < codes.length; i++) {
                    var c = codes[i];
                    if (!isFinite(c) || c === 0)      { state.fg = null; state.bg = null; state.bold = false; state.dim = false; state.italic = false; state.underline = false; }
                    else if (c === 1)                 { state.bold = true; }
                    else if (c === 2)                 { state.dim = true; }
                    else if (c === 3)                 { state.italic = true; }
                    else if (c === 4)                 { state.underline = true; }
                    else if (c === 22)                { state.bold = false; state.dim = false; }
                    else if (c === 23)                { state.italic = false; }
                    else if (c === 24)                { state.underline = false; }
                    else if (c === 39)                { state.fg = null; }
                    else if (c === 49)                { state.bg = null; }
                    else if (c >= 30 && c <= 37)     { state.fg = ANSI_BASIC[c]; }
                    else if (c >= 40 && c <= 47)     { state.bg = ANSI_BASIC[c - 10]; }
                    else if (c >= 90 && c <= 97)     { state.fg = ANSI_BASIC[c]; }
                    else if (c >= 100 && c <= 107)   { state.bg = ANSI_BASIC[c - 10]; }
                    else if (c === 38 && codes[i+1] === 5) { state.fg = ansi256(codes[i+2] || 0); i += 2; }
                    else if (c === 48 && codes[i+1] === 5) { state.bg = ansi256(codes[i+2] || 0); i += 2; }
                    else if (c === 38 && codes[i+1] === 2) { state.fg = 'rgb(' + (codes[i+2]||0) + ',' + (codes[i+3]||0) + ',' + (codes[i+4]||0) + ')'; i += 4; }
                    else if (c === 48 && codes[i+1] === 2) { state.bg = 'rgb(' + (codes[i+2]||0) + ',' + (codes[i+3]||0) + ',' + (codes[i+4]||0) + ')'; i += 4; }
                }
            }
            function emitRun(parent, text, state) {
                if (!text) return;
                if (!state.fg && !state.bg && !state.bold && !state.dim && !state.italic && !state.underline) {
                    parent.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text));
                    return;
                }
                var span = document.createElement('span');
                var css = '';
                if (state.fg) css += 'color:' + state.fg + ';';
                if (state.bg) css += 'background:' + state.bg + ';';
                if (state.bold) css += 'font-weight:bold;';
                if (state.dim) css += 'opacity:0.65;';
                if (state.italic) css += 'font-style:italic;';
                if (state.underline) css += 'text-decoration:underline;';
                span.style.cssText = css;
                span.textContent = text;
                parent.appendChild(span);
            }
            function appendAnsiText(parent, text) {
                var re = /\x1b\[([0-9;]*)m/g;
                var state = { fg: null, bg: null, bold: false, dim: false, italic: false, underline: false };
                var last = 0;
                var m;
                while ((m = re.exec(text)) !== null) {
                    if (m.index > last) emitRun(parent, text.slice(last, m.index), state);
                    applyAnsiCodes(state, m[1]);
                    last = re.lastIndex;
                }
                if (last < text.length) emitRun(parent, text.slice(last), state);
            }

            /* ── Render chunks ── */
            var PREFIX = { stdout: 'out', stderr: 'err', system: 'sys' };

            function appendChunks(chunks) {
                var query = searchInput.value.trim();
                chunks.forEach(function (chunk) {
                    var line = document.createElement('span');
                    line.className = 'line ' + chunk.source;

                    var prefix = document.createElement('span');
                    prefix.className = 'prefix';
                    var srcLabel = '[' + (PREFIX[chunk.source] || chunk.source) + ']';
                    prefix.textContent = (chunk.ts ? chunk.ts + '  ' : '') + srcLabel;

                    line.appendChild(prefix);
                    appendAnsiText(line, chunk.content + '\n');
                    terminal.insertBefore(line, cursor);

                    afterId = Math.max(afterId, chunk.id);
                    lineCount++;
                });
                lineCountEl.textContent = lineCount + ' line' + (lineCount !== 1 ? 's' : '');
                if (query) {
                    applySearch(query);
                } else {
                    scrollToBottom();
                }
            }

            /* ── Search ── */
            function applySearch(query) {
                var lines = terminal.querySelectorAll('.line');
                if (!query) {
                    lines.forEach(function (l) { l.classList.remove('search-hidden'); });
                    searchCountTxt.textContent = '';
                    searchCount.className = 'search-count';
                    searchEscTip.style.display = 'none';
                    scrollToBottom();
                    return;
                }
                var lower = query.toLowerCase();
                var matched = 0;
                lines.forEach(function (l) {
                    var text = l.textContent.toLowerCase();
                    if (text.indexOf(lower) !== -1) {
                        l.classList.remove('search-hidden');
                        matched++;
                    } else {
                        l.classList.add('search-hidden');
                    }
                });
                searchCountTxt.textContent = matched + ' match' + (matched !== 1 ? 'es' : '');
                searchCount.className = 'search-count ' + (matched > 0 ? 'has-results' : 'no-results');
                searchEscTip.style.display = '';
            }

            searchInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
                applySearch(searchInput.value.trim());
            });

            searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                    searchInput.value = '';
                    applySearch('');
                }
            });

            /* ── Update state badge ── */
            function updateBadge(state) {
                badge.textContent = state || '—';
                badge.className = 'job-state-badge state-' + (state || 'pending');
            }

            /* ── Poll loop (fallback for the websocket below) ── */
            var pollTimer = null;
            function scheduleNext(delay) {
                if (!polling) return;
                if (pollTimer !== null) clearTimeout(pollTimer);
                pollTimer = setTimeout(function () {
                    pollTimer = null;
                    poll();
                }, delay);
            }
            function poll() {
                rpc('load_chunks', [JOB_ID, afterId])
                    .then(function (result) {
                        if (!result) return;
                        appendChunks(result.chunks || []);
                        updateBadge(result.state);

                        if (DONE_STATES.indexOf(result.state) !== -1) {
                            polling = false;
                            cursor.style.display = 'none';
                            statusText.textContent = 'Job ' + result.state + '.';
                        } else {
                            statusText.textContent = 'Running…';
                        }
                    })
                    .catch(function (err) {
                        statusText.textContent = 'Connection error — retrying…';
                    })
                    .finally(function () { scheduleNext(POLL_MS); });
            }

            /* ── Websocket: push-based invalidation ──
             *
             * Raw WebSocket speaks Odoo's bus protocol directly:
             *   client subscribes → server pushes JSON arrays of
             *   ``{id, message: {type, payload}}`` on each cloud_jobs
             *   event. Payload is intentionally thin (``{id: job_id}``)
             *   so we don't leak data through the unpermissioned bus —
             *   the HTTP ``load_chunks`` RPC enforces ACLs.
             *
             * The bundled ``bus_service`` is not loaded on this
             * standalone template (would pull in the whole backend
             * bundle), so we talk the protocol inline.
             *
             * Behavior:
             *   - On every matching push, poll now (and reset the
             *     10 s fallback timer via scheduleNext).
             *   - On disconnect, reconnect with 1→30 s exponential
             *     backoff until the job reaches a done state.
             */
            var ws = null;
            var wsRetry = 1000;
            function openWs() {
                if (!polling) return;
                var scheme = (location.protocol === 'https:') ? 'wss' : 'ws';
                var wsUrl = scheme + '://' + location.host + '/websocket?version=' + encodeURIComponent(WS_VERSION);
                try { ws = new WebSocket(wsUrl); }
                catch (_e) { setTimeout(openWs, wsRetry); wsRetry = Math.min(wsRetry * 2, 30000); return; }
                ws.onopen = function () {
                    wsRetry = 1000;
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({
                        event_name: 'subscribe',
                        data: { channels: ['cloud_jobs'], last: 0 },
                    }));
                };
                ws.onmessage = function (ev) {
                    var notifs;
                    try { notifs = JSON.parse(ev.data); } catch (_e) { return; }
                    if (!Array.isArray(notifs)) return;
                    var matched = false;
                    for (var i = 0; i < notifs.length; i++) {
                        var m = notifs[i] && notifs[i].message;
                        if (m && m.type === 'cloud_jobs' && m.payload && m.payload.id === JOB_ID) {
                            matched = true; break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (matched) {
                        if (pollTimer !== null) { clearTimeout(pollTimer); pollTimer = null; }
                        poll();
                    }
                };
                ws.onclose = function () {
                    ws = null;
                    if (polling) {
                        setTimeout(openWs, wsRetry);
                        wsRetry = Math.min(wsRetry * 2, 30000);
                    }
                };
                ws.onerror = function () { try { ws.close(); } catch (_e) {} };
            }

            poll();
            openWs();
        })();
